summary: BHP Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on 25 August 2026, reporting routine share transactions by Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMRs), including CEO Brandon Craig, President Americas Jessica Farrell, and President Australia Geraldine Slattery. The transactions involved acquisitions of ordinary shares (ISIN AU000000BHP4) upon vesting of Management Award Plan awards and deferred rights, plus on-market sales at AUD 65.18 per share to cover tax obligations, all executed on 21 August 2026. These are standard equity compensation disclosures under UK/EU market abuse regulations, equivalent to a US Form 4 filing. No special situation, M&A activity, capital restructuring, or strategic event is involved. The filing is purely routine administrative notification with no deal terms or corporate action implications, so no special-situation classification applies.
